test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is organised by the Government of Karnataka, usually in January, to celebrate the grandeur of temples at a UNESCO heritage site?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pattadakal Dance Festival **__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Government of Karnataka**

 
 
• **Pattadakal Dance Festival **is organised by the Government of **Karnataka**, usually in **January**, to celebrate the grandeur of temples at a **UNESCO **heritage site.
 
• **​**The **Government **of **Karnataka**, often known as the **Karnataka **Government or just the Karnataka Government and formerly known as the Government of **Mysore**, is a democratically elected state body whose governor serves as the state's **ceremonial **head.
 
• On the chief **minister's **recommendation, the **governor**, who is in office for **five **years, names his council of **ministers**.
 
• The **chief minister** and his council of ministers, who are given extensive legislative authority, manage the **government **on a daily basis even while the **governor **continues to serve as the state's **ceremonial leader**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Pattadakal Dance Festival **

 
 
• **​**A little village in **Karnataka **called **Pattadakallu**, sometimes known as **Pattadakal**, is a prime example of **Indian architecture**.
 
• This village, which sits on the banks of the **Malaprabha **River, has been designated a **UNESCO **World Heritage Site.
 
• The word** "Pattadakallu"** means** "site of coronation." **As the name implies, this location served as the site of the **Chalukya dynasty's** coronation **ceremonies**, giving it significant historical and cultural value.
